content:
{
  "requirements": [
    {
      "id": "SL-FT-01",
      "text": "The system shall receive GPS positions from every SAM device and cellular app and display them on a map in near real time.",
      "kind": "functional",
      "priority": "mandatory",
      "status": "explicit",
      "source_passage": "SL-FT-01 The system shall receive GPS positions...",
      "ambiguity": null
    },
    {
      "id": "SL-FT-02",
      "text": "The system shall store the full position history of every tracked unit and allow playback of any time window.",
      "kind": "functional",
      "priority": "mandatory",
      "status": "explicit",
      "source_passage": "SL-FT-02 The system shall store the full position history...",
      "ambiguity": null
    },
    {
      "id": "SL-FT-03",
      "text": "The system shall show the last known position and the age of the position for units that stop reporting.",
      "kind": "functional",
      "priority": "mandatory",
      "status": "explicit",
      "source_passage": "SL-FT-03 The system shall show the last known position...",
      "ambiguity": null
    },
    {
      "id": "SL-FT-04",
      "text": "The system shall support geofences and raise an alert when a unit enters or leaves one.",
      "kind": "functional",
      "priority": "mandatory",
      "status": "explicit",
      "source_passage": "SL-FT-04 The system shall support geofences...",
      "ambiguity": null
    },
    {
      "id": "SL-MAP-01",
      "text": "The map shall display base map, elevation, friendly units, detections, routes and geofences as selectable layers.",
      "kind": "functional",
      "priority": "mandatory",
      "status": "explicit",
      "source_passage": "SL-MAP-01 The map shall display base map...",
      "ambiguity": null
    },
    {
      "id": "SL-MAP-02",
      "text": "The map shall work without internet connectivity using pre-loaded map tiles.",
      "kind": "functional",
      "priority": "mandatory",
      "status": "explicit",
      "source_passage": "SL-MAP-02 The map shall work without internet connectivity...",
      "ambiguity": null
    },
    {
      "id": "SL-RT-01",
      "text": "The system shall compute a route between two points taking terrain and user-defined no-go areas into account.",
      "kind": "functional",
      "priority": "mandatory",
      "status": "explicit",
      "source_passage": "SL-RT-01 The system shall compute a route...",
      "ambiguity": null
    },
    {
      "id": "SL-RT-02",
      "text": "The system shall estimate the time of arrival for a unit on a planned route and update it from live positions.",
      "kind": "functional",
      "priority": "mandatory",
      "status": "explicit",
      "source_passage": "SL-RT-02 The system shall estimate the time of arrival...",
      "ambiguity": null
    },
    {
      "id": "SL-EO-01",
      "text": "The system shall ingest live video from EO sensors and record it.",
      "kind": "functional",
      "priority": "mandatory",
      "status": "explicit",
      "source_passage": "SL-EO-01 The system shall ingest live video...",
      "ambiguity": null
    },
    {
      "id": "SL-EO-02",
      "text": "The system shall detect and classify people and vehicles in video.",
      "kind": "functional",
      "priority": "mandatory",
      "status": "explicit",
      "source_passage": "SL-EO-02 The system shall detect and classify...",
      "ambiguity": null
    },
    {
      "id": "SL-EO-03",
      "text": "The system shall track detected objects across frames and assign track IDs.",
      "kind": "functional",
      "priority": "mandatory",
      "status": "explicit",
      "source_passage": "SL-EO-03 The system shall track detected objects...",
      "ambiguity": null
    },
    {
      "id": "SL-EO-04",
      "text": "The system should provide semantic segmentation of terrain (road, vegetation, building, water).",
      "kind": "functional",
      "priority": "desirable",
      "status": "explicit",
      "source_passage": "SL-EO-04 The system should provide semantic segmentation...",
      "ambiguity": null
    },
    {
      "id": "SL-EO-05",
      "text": "The system should detect changes between two images of the same area taken at different times.",
      "kind": "functional",
      "priority": "desirable",
      "status": "explicit",
      "source_passage": "SL-EO-05 The system should detect changes...",
      "ambiguity": null
    },
    {
      "id": "SL-EO-06",
      "text": "The system should generate short natural-language captions describing a video clip.",
      "kind": "functional",
      "priority": "desirable",
      "status": "explicit",
      "source_passage": "SL-EO-06 The system should generate short natural-language captions...",
      "ambiguity": null
    },
    {
      "id": "SL-EO-07",
      "text": "Detections shall be geo-referenced and shown on the map.",
      "kind": "functional",
      "priority": "mandatory",
      "status": "explicit",
      "source_passage": "SL-EO-07 Detections shall be geo-referenced...",
      "ambiguity": null
    },
    {
      "id": "SL-SF-01",
      "text": "The system shall normalize messages from heterogeneous sensors into a single common data model.",
      "kind": "functional",
      "priority": "mandatory",
      "status": "explicit",
      "source_passage": "SL-SF-01 The system shall normalize messages...",
      "ambiguity": null
    },
    {
      "id": "SL-SF-02",
      "text": "The system shall fuse detections from multiple sensors and EO analytics into a single track picture, removing duplicates.",
      "kind": "functional",
      "priority": "mandatory",
      "status": "explicit",
      "source_passage": "SL-SF-02 The system shall fuse detections...",
      "ambiguity": null
    },
    {
      "id": "SL-OD-01",
      "text": "Operators shall record timestamped diary entries, optionally linked to a unit, track, detection or map location.",
      "kind": "functional",
      "priority": "mandatory",
      "status": "explicit",
      "source_passage": "SL-OD-01 Operators shall record timestamped diary entries...",
      "ambiguity": null
    },
    {
      "id": "SL-OD-02",
      "text": "Diary entries shall be searchable by text, time and linked object.",
      "kind": "functional",
      "priority": "mandatory",
      "status": "explicit",
      "source_passage": "SL-OD-02 Diary entries shall be searchable...",
      "ambiguity": null
    },
    {
      "id": "SL-AL-01",
      "text": "An emergency button press on a SAM device shall raise a high-priority alert at the command post and on team-leader apps.",
      "kind": "functional",
      "priority": "mandatory",
      "status": "explicit",
      "source_passage": "SL-AL-01 An emergency button press...",
      "ambiguity": null
    },
    {
      "id": "SL-AL-02",
      "text": "The system shall send alerts to SW-Watch devices, and the wearer shall be able to acknowledge them; acknowledgements shall be visible at the command post.",
      "kind": "functional",
      "priority": "mandatory",
      "status": "explicit",
      "source_passage": "SL-AL-02 The system shall send alerts to SW-Watch devices...",
      "ambiguity": null
    },
    {
      "id": "SL-AL-03",
      "text": "The system shall display SAM device equipment status (battery, radio, water) and alert on low battery.",
      "kind": "functional",
      "priority": "mandatory",
      "status": "explicit",
      "source_passage": "SL-AL-03 The system shall display SAM device equipment status...",
      "ambiguity": null
    },
    {
      "id": "SL-AL-04",
      "text": "SW-Watch devices shall keep time synchronized with the system.",
      "kind": "functional",
      "priority": "mandatory",
      "status": "explicit",
      "source_passage": "SL-AL-04 SW-Watch devices shall keep time synchronized...",
      "ambiguity": null
    },
    {
      "id": "SL-COM-01",
      "text": "Components shall exchange data through a publish/subscribe messaging layer.",
      "kind": "interface",
      "priority": "mandatory",
      "status": "explicit",
      "source_passage": "SL-COM-01 Components shall exchange data...",
      "ambiguity": null
    },
    {
      "id": "SL-COM-02",
      "text": "The system shall continue to operate in degraded mode when links to the field are intermittent, and deliver queued messages when the link returns.",
      "kind": "functional",
      "priority": "mandatory",
      "status": "explicit",
      "source_passage": "SL-COM-02 The system shall continue to operate in degraded mode...",
      "ambiguity": null
    },
    {
      "id": "SL-APP-01",
      "text": "The cellular app shall show the map, own unit, friendly units and alerts, and allow team leaders to send position reports and diary entries.",
      "kind": "functional",
      "priority": "mandatory",
      "status": "explicit",
      "source_passage": "SL-APP-01 The cellular app shall show the map...",
      "ambiguity": null
    },
    {
      "id": "SL-APP-02",
      "text": "The cellular app shall receive push notifications for high-priority alerts.",
      "kind": "functional",
      "priority": "mandatory",
      "status": "explicit",
      "source_passage": "SL-APP-02 The cellular app shall receive push notifications...",
      "ambiguity": null
    },
    {
      "id": "SL-NF-01",
      "text": "Position updates shall be displayed with low latency.",
      "kind": "nonfunctional",
      "priority": "mandatory",
      "status": "explicit",
      "source_passage": "SL-NF-01 Position updates shall be displayed with low latency.",
      "ambiguity": null
    },
    {
      "id": "SL-NF-02",
      "text": "The system shall be highly available at the command post.",
      "kind": "nonfunctional",
      "priority": "mandatory",
      "status": "explicit",
      "source_passage": "SL-NF-02 The system shall be highly available...",
      "ambiguity": null
    },
    {
      "id": "SL-NF-03",
      "text": "Position history and diary entries shall be retained for as long as needed for after-action review.",
      "kind": "nonfunctional",
      "priority": "mandatory",
      "status": "explicit",
      "source_passage": "SL-NF-03 Position history and diary entries shall be retained...",
      "ambiguity": null
    },
    {
      "id": "SL-NF-04",
      "text": "The video analytics shall run on GPU hardware available at the command post.",
      "kind": "constraint",
      "priority": "mandatory",
      "status": "explicit",
      "source_passage": "SL-NF-04 The video analytics shall run on GPU hardware...",
      "ambiguity": null
    },
    {
      "id": "SL-NF-05",
      "text": "The system shall scale to the number of units in a battalion.",
      "kind": "nonfunctional",
      "priority": "mandatory",
      "status": "explicit",
      "source_passage": "SL-NF-05 The system shall scale to the number of units...",
      "ambiguity": null
    },
    {
      "id": "SL-SEC-01",
      "text": "All data shall remain on-premises at the command post; no data may be sent to public cloud services.",
      "kind": "constraint",
      "priority": "mandatory",
      "status": "explicit",
      "source_passage": "SL-SEC-01 All data shall remain on-premises...",
      "ambiguity": null
    },
    {
      "id": "SL-SEC-02",
      "text": "All communication between components and with field devices shall be encrypted and authenticated.",
      "kind": "constraint",
      "priority": "mandatory",
      "status": "explicit",
      "source_passage": "SL-SEC-02 All communication... shall be encrypted and authenticated.",
      "ambiguity": null
    },
    {
      "id": "SL-SEC-03",
      "text": "Users shall be authenticated and authorized by role (commander, operator, team leader, analyst).",
      "kind": "constraint",
      "priority": "mandatory",
      "status": "explicit",
      "source_passage": "SL-SEC-03 Users shall be authenticated and authorized...",
      "ambiguity": null
    },
    {
      "id": "SL-SEC-04",
      "text": "All operator actions and alerts shall be written to a tamper-evident audit log.",
      "kind": "constraint",
      "priority": "mandatory",
      "status": "explicit",
      "source_passage": "SL-SEC-04 All operator actions and alerts shall be written...",
      "ambiguity": null
    },
    {
      "id": "SL-DEP-01",
      "text": "The command-post software shall run on Linux servers, deployable as containers.",
      "kind": "constraint",
      "priority": "mandatory",
      "status": "explicit",
      "source_passage": "SL-DEP-01 The command-post software shall run on Linux servers...",
      "ambiguity": null
    },
    {
      "id": "SL-DEP-02",
      "text": "Open-source software is permitted only with licenses compatible with redistribution inside a closed defense product.",
      "kind": "constraint",
      "priority": "mandatory",
      "status": "explicit",
      "source_passage": "SL-DEP-02 Open-source software is permitted only...",
      "ambiguity": null
    },
    {
      "id": "INF-01",
      "text": "The system shall provide a mechanism for team leaders to send position reports via the cellular app.",
      "kind": "functional",
      "priority": "mandatory",
      "status": "inferred",
      "source_passage": "SL-APP-01 ...allow team leaders to send position reports...",
      "ambiguity": null
    },
    {
      "id": "INF-02",
      "text": "The system shall provide a mechanism for team leaders to send diary entries via the cellular app.",
      "kind": "functional",
      "priority": "mandatory",
      "status": "inferred",
      "source_passage": "SL-APP-01 ...allow team leaders to ... send diary entries.",
      "ambiguity": null
    }
  ],
  "open_questions": [
    {
      "id": "OQ-01",
      "question": "What is the specific numeric threshold for 'low latency' in SL-NF-01?",
      "requirement_ids": [
        "SL-NF-01"
      ],
      "kind": "missing_value"
    },
    {
      "id": "OQ-02",
      "question": "What is the specific numeric availability target (e.g., 99.9%) for SL-NF-02?",
      "requirement_ids": [
        "SL-NF-02"
      ],
      "kind": "missing_value"
    },
    {
      "id": "OQ-03",
      "question": "What is the specific retention period for position history and diary entries in SL-NF-03?",
      "requirement_ids": [
        "SL-NF-03"
      ],
      "kind": "missing_value"
    },
    {
      "id": "OQ-04",
      "question": "What is the specific battalion size (number of units) that the system must scale to in SL-NF-05?",
      "requirement_ids": [
        "SL-NF-05"
      ],
      "kind": "missing_value"
    },
    {
      "id": "OQ-05",
      "question": "Which specific commercial mobile push-notification service is being considered for SL-APP-02, and does it comply with the on-premises constraint in SL-SEC-01?",
      "requirement_ids": [
        "SL-APP-02",
        "SL-SEC-01"
      ],
      "kind": "contradiction"
    }
  ]
}
